tasks.title: Build the mobile-first visual interaction prototype
tasks.outcome: A runnable 人生试运行 Next.js prototype demonstrates landing, one question, the sequential immediate-insight stack as its visual signature, three equal route covers and responsive/reduced-motion behavior with realistic Chinese content.
done_when: A 360px-wide browser can move from landing to a question, submit a local fixture answer, calibrate an immediate insight and browse all three equal route covers.

The prototype visibly follows Soft Editorial Neo-Brutalism through subtle off-white grid paper, ink, a dominant cobalt accent, green used only for semantic states, 2px borders, 3-4px hard offset shadows, 0-4px corners, restrained mobile density, editorial Chinese serif key statements and sans-serif UI; the sequential immediate-insight stack remains the visual signature, and the result must not resemble a dashboard, childlike interface, generic purple AI landing page, or loud/colorful generic neobrutalism.
Keyboard navigation, 200% zoom and prefers-reduced-motion preserve every operation and all content.
No blocked Lifetide sky or unlicensed pixel-frame asset is present in the build output.
boundaries: Use fixtures only; do not build production AI, authentication, uploads or persistence in this task.
Use neobrutalism.com/RetroUI's Radix registry as the primary component source; neobrutalism.dev is secondary reference only.
Do not add React Bits, Magic UI, Aceternity, Rive, Phaser, Three.js or a second component design system.
Do not copy a registry component without recording its origin, version or commit, and license.
evidence: pnpm build passed (Next.js 16.3.3 + Tailwind v4 + TypeScript)
Playwright E2E suite 14/14 passed on both mobile (360x800) and desktop (1440x900)
Screenshots saved to reports/: landing, question, insight, routes, keyboard, 200% zoom, reduced-motion

tasks.title: Implement guest session, consent and temporary data lifecycle
tasks.outcome: Users can start without registration through a secure server-side guest session; required AI/upload consent is recorded, sensitive data expires after 24 hours, and accounts are only requested for cross-device or extended retention.
done_when: A new visitor receives an opaque HttpOnly guest token and can resume the same session without sensitive content in localStorage.
A deterministic cleanup job deletes expired guest answers, uploads and derived content after the documented retention window.
Upload/model processing cannot start without required consent, while research consent remains optional.
Automated tests prove one guest cannot read or mutate another guest or account session.
boundaries: Do not add social login or a multi-provider account system before the guest path works.
Do not log raw answers or upload content.
evidence: pnpm build passed with Next.js 16.3.3, Prisma 6.6.0 and SQLite
Playwright E2E suite 14/14 passed (TASK-001 regression) and integration suite 6/6 passed (guest session, consent, cleanup, isolation)
Prisma migration applied: sessions, consents, answers, uploads, derived content with ON DELETE CASCADE

checks.criterion: A new visitor receives an opaque HttpOnly guest token and can resume the same session without sensitive content in localStorage.
evidence: app/api/session/route.ts issues a random 64-char token in an HttpOnly / SameSite=lax / 24h cookie
Response body never includes the token; only the cookie contains it
tests/integration/guest-session.test.ts: 'new visitor' and 'same cookie' tests pass

checks.criterion: A deterministic cleanup job deletes expired guest answers, uploads and derived content after the documented retention window.
evidence: app/api/session/cleanup/route.ts deletes all Session rows where expiresAt < now(); FK cascades remove consents, answers, uploads and derived content
Session.expiresAt is set to 24 hours after creation in lib/auth/session.ts
tests/integration/guest-session.test.ts: 'cleanup job deletes expired answers, uploads and derived content' passes

checks.criterion: Upload/model processing cannot start without required consent, while research consent remains optional.
evidence: lib/privacy/consent.ts defines ai and upload as required, research as optional
app/api/answer/route.ts and app/api/upload/route.ts return 403 when required consent is missing
app/api/session/consent/route.ts records consent and updates canUseAI/canUpload flags
tests/integration/guest-session.test.ts: 'AI/upload processing is blocked without consent and allowed after consent' and 'research consent stays optional' pass

checks.criterion: Automated tests prove one guest cannot read or mutate another guest or account session.
evidence: app/api/answer/route.ts, app/api/upload/route.ts and app/api/session/consent/route.ts require a valid guest token cookie
Token is opaque and not correlated with public session id
tests/integration/guest-session.test.ts: 'one guest cannot read or mutate another guest' passes

tasks.title: Implement optional document upload and untrusted parsing boundary
tasks.outcome: Guest and account sessions can optionally upload approved resume, MBTI and text documents, see per-file states, delete them, and expose only sanitized untrusted chunks to later Agent calls.
done_when: The UI supports skip, select, upload, parsing, failure, retry and delete states per file without blocking interview start.
Server validation enforces configured type, size, tenant and malware/parse boundaries independently of client checks.
Parsed chunks are serialized as non-executable untrusted data and malicious instruction fixtures cannot alter prompts, tools or roles.
Deleting a document removes its chunks and invalidates or marks derived memory as unsupported.
boundaries: Uploaded MBTI and resume statements begin as document-reported clues, never confirmed facts.
Do not fetch URLs or execute code found in uploaded content.
evidence: pnpm build passed with Next.js 16.3.3, Prisma 6.6.0, SQLite and Turbopack
Playwright full suite passed 28/28 in default mode (e2e 14/14, integration 14/14)
Crux subagent reviewed TASK-001/TASK-002/TASK-003 against design and reported healthy: true with minor drift addressed
Prisma migration applied: Upload, UploadChunk and DerivedContent with upload-dependent supportStatus and ON DELETE CASCADE/SetNull
Boundary: Uploaded MBTI and resume statements begin as document-reported clues, never confirmed facts
Boundary: Uploaded content is never parsed into URLs, code execution or prompt/tool/role injection

checks.criterion: The UI supports skip, select, upload, parsing, failure, retry and delete states per file without blocking interview start.
evidence: components/upload/UploadPanel.tsx renders skip, empty, selected, uploading, ready, failed and deleted states
app/play/upload/page.tsx is a standalone optional step; landing and /play question flow do not require an upload
UploadPanel polls GET /api/uploads/[id] after POST/retry and updates the file list with status, error and delete controls
Playwright 'upload is optional and starts without consent' and all e2e main-path tests pass without uploading

checks.criterion: Server validation enforces configured type, size, tenant and malware/parse boundaries independently of client checks.
evidence: lib/uploads/config.ts defines UPLOAD_MAX_SIZE (1 MB), allowed MIME types (text/plain, text/markdown, application/json) and parser map
app/api/uploads/route.ts re-validates MIME and size from the actual File, ignoring client-supplied metadata, and returns 415/413
lib/uploads/parse.ts only reads and splits text; no eval(), Function() or URL fetching is performed
Playwright 'rejects disallowed file types regardless of client checks' and 'rejects files exceeding the server size limit' pass

checks.criterion: Parsed chunks are serialized as non-executable untrusted data and malicious instruction fixtures cannot alter prompts, tools or roles.
evidence: app/api/uploads/route.ts stores rawBase64 and creates UploadChunk rows with source/text fields
The parser returns plain { index, source, text } objects; no parsed output is ever inserted into system prompts, tools or role definitions
UploadChunk.text is treated as an untrusted clue; later Agent calls must receive chunks through a fixed, non-executable envelope
Playwright 'malicious instructions are stored as text, not executed or reflected as commands' passes; the response never contains instruction/tool/role fields

checks.criterion: Deleting a document removes its chunks and invalidates or marks derived memory as unsupported.
evidence: app/api/uploads/[id]/route.ts (DELETE) uses a Prisma transaction to update DerivedContent supportStatus to 'unsupported' and then delete chunks and the upload
DerivedContent.uploadId is set to null by the FK onDelete: SetNull, preserving the record while marking it unsupported
Playwright 'deleting an upload removes chunks and marks derived content unsupported' passes

tasks.title: Implement Wave 1, WorkingMemory and immediate calibration
tasks.outcome: The fixed four-question first wave runs without an Interviewer call, Sensemaker produces one evidence-linked insight, and user calibration transactionally updates lightweight WorkingMemory.
done_when: Wave 1 question ids, order, version, skip behavior and wording pass snapshot tests and produce zero Interviewer calls.
Sensemaker output is runtime-schema validated and every insight citation resolves to a current-session source.
Accurate, partly accurate and inaccurate feedback persist distinctly; inaccurate feedback invalidates contradictory claims before replacements are added.
The sequential message-stack UI exposes facts, tentative interpretation, uncertainty and calibration without personality scores.
boundaries: Do not add PersonaSnapshot, CoverageCell, a hypothesis graph or a separate extractor Agent.
Do not present model confidence percentages to users.
evidence: pnpm build passed (Next.js 16.3.3 + Tailwind v4 + TypeScript + Prisma 6.6.0 + SQLite + Turbopack)
Playwright full suite passed 35/35 (e2e 14/14 on mobile and desktop, integration 21/21 including wave-one 7/7)
Wave 1 GET exposes version and deterministic questions; POST persists answers and WorkingMemory; feedback updates WorkingMemory transactionally
Boundaries preserved: no PersonaSnapshot, no coverage metrics, no model confidence percentages shown to users

tasks.title: Implement adaptive waves and deterministic stopping
tasks.outcome: Interviewer generates each later 3-5 question wave around the sole highest-impact plan-changing uncertainty; host rules cap the interview and decide continue, provisional generation or final generation.
done_when: Uncertainty priority and stable tie-breaking pass property tests and the model cannot change the selected focus id.
Every adaptive batch contains 3-5 validated questions for one focus, at least one concrete-experience question and no recently rejected repetition.
The state machine never creates Wave 5 or displays question 20 and preserves committed batches across retry/resume.
Two-wave fixture paths complete with exactly four first-attempt business model calls through final generation eligibility.
boundaries: Production focus selection is deterministic, not random.
Do not add a critic, stop Agent or per-answer model call.

tasks.title: Generate and present three parallel lives and three-day trials
tasks.outcome: Sensemaker final generates exactly three evidence-linked, genuinely different three-year lives; the UI presents them equally and lets the user start, modify, pause, exit and reflect on one reversible three-day trial.
done_when: Every final plan passes schema, citation, pairwise-distinctness, gain/loss, uncertainty, risk and reversible-trial gates.
No data field, copy, position, color or initial focus marks one route as recommended or best.
Mobile carousel and desktop comparison are keyboard/screen-reader operable and preserve equal information hierarchy.
A trial can be edited, paused, exited, switched and reflected without streak punishment or irreversible actions.
boundaries: Use one Sensemaker final call; do not add Planner unless the recorded research decision rule is met.
Do not claim the three-year adaptation is the original Stanford five-year method.

tasks.title: Implement bounded plan conversation and user data controls
tasks.outcome: Users can ask for evidence-linked explanation, compare tradeoffs, refine a trial and reflect on results while chat remains bounded and export/delete operations affect all linked data.
done_when: Only the four documented chat scopes reach the model, each user message makes at most one call, and the 20-turn limit closes with a useful summary.
Chat cannot rank routes, mutate WorkingMemory or plans, read full uploads, perform unrelated tasks or exceed crisis/professional boundaries.
Export includes understandable user-owned session, memory, plan, trial and chat data without internal secrets.
Delete operations remove selected uploads or the entire session and invalidate all dependent citations and outputs.
boundaries: Do not expand this into a general-purpose assistant.
Do not imply live human crisis monitoring or professional care.

tasks.title: Run release verification and moderated MVP research
tasks.outcome: The complete fixture, real-LLM, browser, accessibility, performance, security and moderated-research evidence supports or rejects the Lite product's core claims without hiding known failures.
done_when: All P0 rows in the acceptance matrix have reproducible passing evidence and no unresolved waiver.
Real-LLM reports cover Interviewer, Sensemaker wave, Sensemaker final and chat with fixed synthetic fixtures, version hashes, latency, token, cost, repair and fallback data.
Browser E2E covers shortest, correction, limit, upload-attack, degraded-final, data deletion and chat-boundary scenarios on mobile and desktop.
Moderated research answers the documented questions about two-wave sufficiency, correction, route equality, three-year horizon and three-day trial with recorded decisions.
boundaries: Do not use real participant answers as public golden fixtures.
Do not restore product complexity to improve a metric before testing the simpler mechanism.
